decisions.rationale: Context-budget efficient. Wave 0 RED-stub → Wave 1 client island flips most GREEN → Wave 2 atomic swap flips the last 4 GREEN. Preserves the RED-then-GREEN cadence from Phases 1-4.

decisions.decision: ContactModal is the SOLE 'use client' island (FOUND-07 carve-out)
decisions.rationale: Hash-based trigger architecture (D-06) keeps Nav.tsx + CTAArrowLink as Server Components. Only their href value swaps from '/' to '#contact'. tests/no-client-components.spec.ts is renamed/inverted to single-client-island.spec.ts.

decisions.decision: Atomic D-05 trigger swap binding enforced by git verification
decisions.rationale: Plan 03 Task 1 includes `git log -n 1 --name-only` check that fails if Nav.tsx + about/page.tsx + tests/about-renders.spec.ts + app/layout.tsx aren't all in the same commit. Plan-checker would refuse a split-Wave variant.

decisions.decision: Honeypot+min-time silent-rejection uses separate `bypassedSuccess` state (Pitfall 5 fix)
decisions.rationale: useForm.handleSubmit is never called on the silent-reject path, so state.succeeded never flips. Need a parallel state to render the success UI without bots learning their submission was rejected.

decisions.decision: Modal entrance keyframe is NEW opacity-only `modal-fade-in` (NOT reuse of `fade-in-up`)
decisions.rationale: Existing fade-in-up has 8px translateY which would conflict with browser-centered <dialog> top-layer positioning (Pitfall 6).

decisions.decision: Hash-clear on close uses `history.replaceState(null, '', location.pathname + location.search)`
decisions.rationale: Pitfall 1 — `location.hash = ''` would leave the same '#contact' value cached, so a same-hash click after close wouldn't fire hashchange. replaceState properly clears it.
